mapper.sql: id, uid, symbol, buy_trade_id, sell_trade_id, matched_qty, buy_price, sell_price, buy_time, sell_time, buy_amount, sell_amount, fee_rate, buy_fee_asset, buy_fee_amount, buy_fee_quote_amount, sell_fee_asset, sell_fee_amount, sell_fee_quote_amount, fee_valuation_complete, pnl, fee, net_pnl, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t1.buy_amount), 0) AS total_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(t1.sell_amount), 0) AS total_sell_amount, COALESCE(SUM(t1.pnl), 0) AS pnl, COALESCE(SUM(t1.fee), 0) AS fee, COALESCE(SUM(t1.net_pnl), 0) AS net_pnl, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fee_valuation_complete = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_fee_count FROM binance_spot_trade_match t1 WHERE t1.uid = #{uid} AND t1.symbol = #{symbol}

SELECT fee_asset AS asset, SUM(fee_amount) AS amount, SUM(fee_quote_amount) AS quote_amount FROM ( SELECT buy_fee_asset AS fee_asset, buy_fee_amount AS fee_amount, buy_fee_quote_amount AS fee_quote_amount FROM binance_spot_trade_match WHERE uid = #{uid} AND symbol = #{symbol} UNION ALL SELECT sell_fee_asset AS fee_asset, sell_fee_amount AS fee_amount, sell_fee_quote_amount AS fee_quote_amount FROM binance_spot_trade_match WHERE uid = #{uid} AND symbol = #{symbol} ) fee_rows WHERE fee_asset IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fee_asset ORDER BY fee_asset
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM binance_spot_trade_match WHERE uid = #{uid} AND symbol = #{symbol}
